author: Claude (handoff 112)
status: FROZEN. Committed alone, before any code connects to any endpoint and before a single frame exists.
purpose: Freeze the pilot window, the stopping rule, the record schemas, the decision vocabulary and the prohibitions for a live Pump launch SHADOW observer that never signs, never submits and never spends.
what_this_is: A passive observer of public Solana log notifications. It records what it saw, when it saw it, what it could and could not decode, and what the FROZEN B11b P1 policy would hypothetically have proposed. Nothing it produces is an order, an execution, or a claim of profit.

isolation.may_not_modify: any file in the B11c integrity manifest
isolation.reason: the frozen B11a corpus and the running collection must be untouchable from here; a shadow pilot that can write into the evaluation window is not a shadow

transport.protocol: websocket, RFC 6455, implemented on the standard library because no dependency may be added
transport.endpoint_receipt: scheme and host only, never the path or query
transport.credential: environment only; never an argument, never written to any artifact

fidelity_limitation.headline: THIS IS NOT GEYSER FIDELITY AND MAY NEVER BE DESCRIBED AS SUCH.
unavailable_evidence: orphaned/forked slots — a log notification carries no reorg signal, so a launch observed here may later not exist on the canonical chain and this pilot cannot tell
account updates — no pre/post account state arrives, so reserves at the decision instant are not observable from the feed alone
slot-dead notifications — a skipped or dead slot is invisible, so a gap cannot be distinguished from silence
guaranteed delivery — logsSubscribe is best-effort; a dropped notification leaves no trace in the stream
fidelity_limitation.consequence: every count this pilot produces is a LOWER BOUND on what happened, and every gap it records is a lower bound on what it missed. No completeness claim may be made from it.

window_and_stopping_rule.starts_at: the first successful subscription confirmation, recorded as session_started_wall_unix and session_started_monotonic_ns
window_and_stopping_rule.extension_forbidden_reason: a pilot extended after its operator has seen the numbers is a pilot whose length was chosen by the numbers
early_stop_permitted_only_for: a declared fault: credential absent, endpoint refusing, artifact path unwritable, or a decode-contract mismatch
window_and_stopping_rule.no_result_may_be_reported_before: the stopping rule fires or a declared fault stops the pilot

raw_frame.storage: append-only JSONL; a line once written is never edited or deleted
raw_frame.note: raw_notification_json is the provider's payload EXACTLY as delivered. Everything else in this system is derived from it and can be recomputed; it cannot.

decision.outcome_placeholder: always null in this pilot; the field exists so a later pass can fill it without changing the schema

policy.source: the FROZEN B11b policy definition, re-instantiated; no B11b figure is imported
policy.size_justification: 0.1 SOL, unchanged from B10a/B10b/B10c/B11b. Reusing the existing size means no size was chosen with this pilot in view.
policy.vetoes: the exact B11b hard veto set, applied unchanged
policy.risk_governor: B12a semantics applied where inputs are available; its ratification stays operator_unratified
policy.unknown_input_rule: unknown, stale or incomplete input means NO SHADOW ENTRY with a reason code. Never a default, never an assumed value, never a zero.

reason_codes.meaning: reserves at the decision instant are not observable from logs alone and backfill did not supply them
the launch transaction could not be retrieved
the create payload did not decode under the pinned IDL
a B11b hard veto fired; the specific veto is recorded
B12a rejected the hypothetical proposal; the governor's own reason is recorded
the decision instant is further from the observation instant than the declared freshness bound
a gap or reconnect makes this observation's completeness unknown
the stopping rule has already fired

freshness_bound_justification: 30 seconds, measured on the MONOTONIC clock. Chosen before any latency was observed, so it cannot have been fitted to the distribution it bounds. A decision older than this is recorded as stale rather than acted on hypothetically.

passive_measurements.name: feed_latency_ns
passive_measurements.definition: frame received monotonic minus the provider's slot-implied instant where derivable; otherwise inter-frame arrival statistics only
passive_measurements.honest_limitation: logsSubscribe carries no provider send timestamp, so absolute one-way latency is NOT measurable; what is measurable is arrival spacing and observation-to-decision time

passive_measurements.name: gap_rate
passive_measurements.definition: suspected gaps per session hour, from slot discontinuity in observed frames

passive_measurements.name: backfill_latency_ns
passive_measurements.definition: monotonic time from decode to backfill completion

passive_measurements.name: decode_unknown_rate
passive_measurements.definition: unknown_event plus decode_failed over all candidate frames

passive_measurements.name: observation_to_decision_ns
passive_measurements.definition: monotonic time from frame receipt to policy result

strictly_forbidden: wallet or key material of any kind, in memory, in a file, or in an environment variable read by this pilot
tips, priority fees, or any spending
any claim that a result is executable, live, profitable or production ready
adding any window to B14c eligible_windows
reading or writing the B11a corpus
altering or restarting the B11c watcher or any manifest-pinned file

publishes: the stopping rule and progress toward it
never_publishes: any mint, curve, creator or signature
any hypothetical size or simulated figure
operator_status_command.never_publishes_reason: a status line is read by people and pasted into places; identities and figures do not belong in one
